title: Topdeck
pitch: The website for Topdeck, a Gods Unchained podcast: play every episode right in the browser and send the hosts feedback.
description: Episodes and listener feedback live in Postgres through Prisma, and a login-protected admin lets the hosts publish new episodes and read what listeners sent.

externals.name: Postgres database
externals.note: The live site runs on the real episode database; running it locally needs your own Postgres.
